collections.name: Bitcoin Birds
registryNote: Bitcoin Birds is a collection of 400 pixel-art birds on Stacks, numbered 0 to 399. Every file is a small PNG (3 to 8 KB), so the whole set is about 2 MB.

The collection’s contract stores one link for all of its birds, and that link (stacksart.com/assets/birds.json) now returns an ordinary web page, not token data. The pictures themselves are kept in a single IPFS folder that marketplaces such as Gamma read from. Nothing on the chain names that folder.

That made Birds one of the clearest cases for a backup: a complete collection whose only route to its art was a third party’s index. All 400 twins were inscribed by the Xtrata team, with the helper fee set to zero for this collection.
